ticker_news.title: BizClik Releases October 2025 Sustainability Portfolio Editions
ticker_news.description: Sustainability Magazine's October 2025 issue features executive interviews and insights on sustainability, including perspectives from Schneider Electric, Radisson Hotel Group, PepsiCo, IBM, Google, and NetApp on decarbonization and climate action strategies.
ticker_news.author: Izzy Hutchin

ticker_news.title: 3 Growth Stocks to Invest $1,000 in Right Now
ticker_news.description: The AI revolution is reshaping the tech industry, with Nvidia, Taiwan Semiconductor, and Alphabet emerging as key players driving technological innovation and infrastructure development in artificial intelligence.
ticker_news.author: Adam Spatacco

ticker_news.title: Big Money Moves: Investment Advisor Stocks Up on Often-Overlooked Artificial Intelligence (AI) Stock
ticker_news.description: Sander Capital Advisors Inc added 18,880 Oracle shares worth $4.81 million in Q3 2025, making Oracle its 5th-largest holding at 10% of assets under management, signaling confidence in the company's AI and data center expansion strategy.
ticker_news.author: Jake Lerch

ticker_news.title: Investment Advisor Pulls Plug on Software Giant, Recent Filing Shows
ticker_news.description: Shaker Investments sold its entire $2.94 million stake in Salesforce during Q3 2025, citing underperformance and potential AI-related challenges in the software industry.
ticker_news.author: Jake Lerch

ticker_news.title: Investment Manager Takes a Big Step Back From Software Giant
ticker_news.description: Shaker Investments sold approximately 2,910 shares of ServiceNow, reducing its portfolio exposure by about 75%, potentially signaling concerns about the company's performance amid shifting market sentiment towards AI-driven technologies.
ticker_news.author: Jake Lerch
